name: lit-wasm-plugin
description: An experiment with Extism + Lit for SSR

scripts.install:webawesome: git submodule update --init --recursive && cd webawesome && git checkout konnorrogers/working-on-ssr && npm install && npm run build && cd -
scripts.bootstrap: npm run install:extism && npm run install:webawesome && npm install
scripts.build:check: tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
scripts.build: node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
